items.markdown:
The Thailand Elite Visa (now officially the Thailand Privilege Card) requires `meeting basic personal qualifications, paying a one-time membership fee starting at THB 650,000, and passing a background check`.[](https://rumavi.com/en/property-guides/thailand-elite-visa) [[1]](https://rumavi.com/en/property-guides/thailand-elite-visa)[[2]](https://harveylawcorporation.com/thailand-elite-visa/)[[3]](https://www.thailandelite.net/pricing)

General Qualifications

- **Passport:** Hold a valid foreign passport with at least 3 blank pages.
- **Immigration History:** Must be legally allowed to stay in Thailand, meaning no history of overstaying rules or visa violations.
- **Criminal Record:** Must have no criminal convictions in any country (excluding minor offenses due to negligence).
- **Legal Status:** Must not have been declared bankrupt, of unsound mind, or legally incompetent.
- **Age Limits:** No minimum age requirement for most tiers, except select packages requiring applicants to be at least 20 years old.[](https://www.elitevisa.com/thailand-elite-visa-overview/) [[1]](https://www.elitevisa.com/thailand-elite-visa-overview/)[[2]](https://thailand-elite.mailchimpsites.com/)

Cost and Tiers

- **Bronze Tier:** THB 650,000 for a 5-year stay (entry-level option).
- **Higher Tiers:** Range up to THB 5,000,000 for packages lasting 15 to 20 years, depending on VIP privileges included.[](https://immigrantinvest.com/thailand-elite-visa/) [[1]](https://immigrantinvest.com/thailand-elite-visa/)

Application Process

- **Background Check:** Requires submission of a copy of your passport, application form, and photo for a criminal and immigration record clearance by Thai authorities (typically takes 4 to 6 weeks).
- **Fee Payment:** Once approved, pay the package fee directly to the program.
- **Visa Affixation:** Get the visa sticker placed in your passport at an authorized immigration office or Thai embassy.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SXH1bw8ZtM8&t=84) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SXH1bw8ZtM8&t=84)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDs3u28F1Ok&t=109)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3qetmcnOL0w&t=72)[[4]](https://thailandelitevisa.com/)

If you would like, I can provide details on:

- **Specific tier privileges** (airport fast-track, points system)
- **Tax implications** of staying long-term in Thailand
- **Required documents** for your specific nationality

Let me know how you would like to proceed.
